learning_objective: 🎯 We will have fun measuring things using our hands and feet, and discover the magic of shadows!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the sun shines on us, we can see our dark shadow on the ground! Shadows change their size. Sometimes they are very long, and sometimes they are short.
We do not always need a scale. We can measure a table using our hands (handspan). We can measure a room by counting our footsteps!
Some things are very long, like a snake or a rope. Some things are short, like a tiny pencil or a bug. We can place them side by side to compare.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Shadow Catching
fun_activity.instructions: Go outside in the morning sun. Ask your friend to draw an outline of your shadow on the ground with a piece of chalk!

quick_recap: ⭐ Shadows are made when light shines on objects.
⭐ We can use our hands and feet to measure how long things are.
⭐ We can easily see which object is longer and which is shorter.
